name: Yatabe Hayato
source: Protagonist's coworker. He is very popular with women because of his good looking and smooth talking. However, all of that are just a facade bellied a sly, cunning and cruel nature. An evil bastard who does not hesitate to use his lover to take down his colleague and steal all of his achievements.
